主要内容: On July 15, 2013, Optical Cable Corporation (OCC) declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.02 per share on its common stock, effective July 12, 2013. The dividend will be paid on August 15, 2013, to shareholders of record on July 29, 2013. This represents an annual cash dividend of $0.08 per common share. The dividend is the third quarterly dividend declared by the Board of Directors during fiscal year 2013, with the next dividend expected in October 2013. OCC is a leading manufacturer of fiber optic and copper data communication cabling and connectivity solutions for the enterprise market.
